porosity_and_wash_out_guidance: Great for fine or low-porosity hair during blowouts/serums; does not build up on its own (though often paired with heavier silicones in serums).

Binds specifically to damaged spots on the hair cuticle and resists stacking infinitely on healthy hair.
porosity_and_wash_out_guidance: Ideal for high-porosity, color-treated, or tangled coils; self-limiting film resists heavy buildup, removable with gentle surfactant cleansers.

how_it_behaves_on_coily_hair:

Coats the hair shaft to lock out humidity, smooth split ends, and shield hair from heat.
porosity_and_wash_out_guidance: Best for heat protection (silk presses/blowouts) and high-porosity frizz control; requires periodic clarifying shampoo to prevent buildup.

linked_inci_ids: ING-038 (Cetyl Alcohol), ING-056(Cetearyl Alcohol), ING-085 (Stearyl Alcohol), ING-086 (Behenyl Alcohol)
how_it_behaves_on_coily_hair: Waxy, plant-derived lipids that soften rough cuticles, thicken conditioners, and give creamy detangling slip.
porosity_and_wash_out_guidance: Great for all porosities; completely non-drying and rinses clean without stripping moisture.

how_it_behaves_on_coily_hair: Used in tiny amounts (≤1%) to keep water-based products free of bacteria and mold—not to evaporate water from hair.
porosity_and_wash_out_guidance: Safe for all hair types at preservative levels; only flag if you have a known fragrance/preservative allergy.

linked_inci_ids: Alcohol Denat., SD Alcohol 40, Isopropyl Alcohol, Ethanol (not yet in DB)
how_it_behaves_on_coily_hair: Evaporates fast to help sprays, mousses, or edge controls dry quickly, which can pull moisture from the hair shaft if used high up on the label.
porosity_and_wash_out_guidance: Avoid high concentrations on dry, high-porosity, or fragile coils; fine in trace amounts near the bottom of an INCI list.

linked_inci_ids: ING-017 (Creatine), plus Silk Amino Acids, Wheat Amino Acids, Arginine
how_it_behaves_on_coily_hair: Tiny individual protein fragments that slip easily inside the hair fiber to boost elasticity and moisture retention without stiff coating.
porosity_and_wash_out_guidance: Safe for all porosities—even low-porosity or protein-sensitive hair that gets stiff from larger proteins.

linked_inci_ids: ING-053 (Hydrolyzed Silk), ING-054 (Hydrolyzed Rice Protein), ING-075 (Hydrolyzed Quinoa)
how_it_behaves_on_coily_hair: Small-to-medium plant and silk proteins that add shine, body, and light cuticle smoothing without a heavy or rigid cast.
porosity_and_wash_out_guidance: Ideal for fine-to-medium coils and medium porosity; easy for most protein-cautious hair to tolerate.

how_it_behaves_on_coily_hair: Larger film-forming proteins that patch gaps along damaged cuticles and temporarily boost strength against snapping.
porosity_and_wash_out_guidance: Best for high-porosity, heat-styled, bleached, or relaxed coils; space out use on low-porosity hair to avoid stiffness.

how_it_behaves_on_coily_hair: Calms scalp oxidative stress and shows promising lab activity on hair follicle cells.
porosity_and_wash_out_guidance: Good for all scalp types in leave-in serums; promising early science, though human regrowth isn't clinically proven.

how_it_behaves_on_coily_hair: Stimulates local scalp microcirculation and helps counter follicle stress in leave-on scalp formulas.
porosity_and_wash_out_guidance: Works well in daily scalp/edge serums; backed by promising topical studies, though results vary by formula.

how_it_behaves_on_coily_hair: Strengthens the scalp's moisture barrier, soothes redness, and keeps flaky or dry skin balanced.
porosity_and_wash_out_guidance: Great for dry, irritated, or protective-style scalps; supports healthy scalp skin rather than directly regrowing hair.

linked_inci_ids: ING-025 (Copper Tripeptide-1), ING-045 (Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1 / Procapil™), ING-046 (Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3 / Capixyl™)
how_it_behaves_on_coily_hair: Short amino-acid messengers engineered to support root anchoring, scalp comfort, and hair density without weighing strands down.
porosity_and_wash_out_guidance: Emerging, formula-specific science; distinct from shaft-strengthening proteins so they won't cause protein stiffness.

linked_inci_ids: ING-083 (Sodium Lauryl Sulfate) and ING-084 (Sodium Laureth Sulfate).
how_it_behaves_on_coily_hair: Strong negatively charged cleansers that strip heavy oils, silicones, waxes, and scalp buildup fast.
porosity_and_wash_out_guidance: Best reserved for periodic clarifying or stubborn buildup—too stripping for weekly wash days on dry 3C–4C coils.

linked_inci_ids: ING-030 (Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate), ING-031(Cocamidopropyl Betaine), ING-032 (Sodium Methyl Oleoyl Taurate), ING-034 (Coco-Glucoside), ING-035 (PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate)
